jobs.description: Berlin • Cybersecurity & AI Startup • Recently Funded A newly funded cybersecurity startup in Berlin is looking for a Engineering Team Lead to join as a founding team member and help design the core security, identity, and enforcement foundations of a next-generation AI-powered risk management platform. We are an early-stage startup founded by experienced cybersecurity leaders with backgrounds in Israeli intelligence units. We are looking for a hands-on Founding Engineering Team Lead for a hybrid role based in central Berlin. If you are passionate about cybersecurity and AI, thrive in fast-paced startup environments, and enjoy building complex platforms from the ground up, this is an opportunity to make a real impact. They’re building a next-generation cyber risk platform that helps enterprises understand, measure, and reduce identity risk at scale. Their goal is to turn complex identity and security data into clear, actionable risk insights that CISOs and CTOs can trust. You will work from scratch on core platform components from day one, shaping how modern enterprises manage and reason about risk using cloud-native systems, AI-driven analysis, and automated enforcement through AI agents. Key Responsibilities: Lead and grow a small, high-performing engineering team while remaining hands-on Design, build, and review production backend and platform code alongside the team Own delivery of the engineering roadmap , balancing speed, quality, and security Act as a technical leader by setting architecture direction and enforcing engineering standards Contribute directly to critical features, integrations, and platform foundations Establish lightweight engineering processes that enable fast execution without bureaucracy Mentor engineers through code reviews , pairing, and technical guidance Contribute hands-on in design and build architecture, configure systems, code 70% of the time in GoLang. jobs.title: Product Designer (m/f/x)
jobs.description: UP42 was founded in 2019 with a clear purpose: to transform how organizations order, access, and analyze Earth observation data. Our platform brings together the world’s leading geospatial providers, and offers a single touchpoint to access, manage, and process data at scale. From vegetation management and infrastructure monitoring to disaster response, UP42 helps organizations across industries find solutions to complex problems through Earth observation. Our expert support team and detailed documentation guide our users through every step. Since July 2025, UP42 has been a part of Neo Space Group. We are looking for a Product Designer (m/f/x) to join our Design Team in Berlin. You will be the design partner for one of our product teams, working alongside a Product Manager and engineers to take work from an early idea through to something people use. You will own your projects, hold a high quality bar on complex, data-rich interfaces, and work inside a design system you help keep healthy. You will enjoy this role if you want real ownership of a product area without carrying a whole platform, and if you like going deep into a genuinely complex domain. Our team is complementary, so your work is visible and the feedback loop is short. What you will do: Take design work from an early idea through to delivery, proposing solutions to blockers rather than only reporting them. Be the reliable design partner for your product team: the person your PM and engineers come to first. Design for complexity: dense data tables, long-running processes, and workflows where the edge cases matter as much as the main path. Look for evidence before you design: talk to users, read what support and sales already know, look at how the product is actually used, and run tests on your own work. Push to understand the problem before designing a solution, and say so when a brief arrives already shaped as one. jobs.description: Teamwork makes the stream work.   Roku is changing how the world watches TV Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we ve set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers. From your first day at Roku, you ll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We re a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.     About the team At Roku, the UI Systems team builds the high-performance engines and core graphics infrastructure that power millions of devices. We own the low-level C++ frameworks, rendering pipelines, and system architectures that enable smooth navigation and rich animations. Our work sits at the intersection of hardware and software, where we optimize graphics rendering, memory management, and layout engines to ensure a consistent, lightning-fast experience across our entire device portfolio. We operate in a collaborative, high-trust environment, partnering closely with firmware and silicon teams to push the boundaries of what’s possible on embedded hardware. About the role As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a key architect of the core systems that underpin Roku’s user experience. You will design and implement performance-critical code within our UI engine, focusing on graphics primitives, memory efficiency, and hardware acceleration. You’ll tackle complex systems-level challenges—such as optimizing frame rates on resource-constrained hardware and building robust APIs for higher-level frameworks. jobs.title: Content Designer | LATAM
jobs.description: Location : Remote – Central or South America (Open to applicants anywhere in Central or South America) Fueled is a leading digital strategy, design, and engineering agency. We are a 300+ person team that has designed and built hundreds of digital products and experiences for brands like Google, Apple, The New York Times, ESPN, Victoria’s Secret, MGM Resorts, Albertsons, and CLEAR. As a Senior Content Designer at Fueled, you’ll bring clarity to complex product experiences through thoughtful, strategic content design. You’ll partner closely with design, product, and engineering teams to shape content systems that scale by moving beyond copy to define structure, meaning, and user understanding across digital products. Intentionally remote, our team thrives in a culture that values flexibility, creativity, and cutting-edge technology. Together, we’re shaping the future of digital experiences. What you will do: Lead content design across client engagements, shaping clear, user-centered experiences through content strategy, UX writing, and information architecture. Translate ambiguous product and business goals into structured content models, messaging frameworks, and scalable content systems. Write and adapt content to meet client needs, balancing brand voice, user experience, and business objectives. Collaborate with product designers, engineers, and stakeholders to integrate content seamlessly into the product development process. Define and deliver key content artifacts (e.g., audits, taxonomies, content models, voice and tone guidelines) while facilitating workshops to align teams on strategy and direction. What you will achieve: Deliver content systems and experiences that improve clarity, usability, and overall product effectiveness. Create scalable content foundations that support long-term product growth and consistency across platforms. Help teams move from ambiguity to clarity by structuring content in ways that enable confident design and engineering decisions

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description: Kinsta is one of the top providers of managed hosting for WordPress, with a growing club of 120,000+ businesses including startups, universities, and Fortune 500 firms. We're motivated by excellent quality and proud to have received a 97% satisfaction rating from our customers. That's because, to us, each day is a chance to grow. As a team, we continuously inspire each other to learn new and better ways to make an impact. We own our jobs proudly - our leaders don't hold our hands, but they're in our corner whenever we ask for help - and our environment is flexible and remote-first. As our new Senior Product Designer , you'll lead and execute product initiatives from concept to UI, bringing a user-focused mentality to everything you ship. You'll join a small, close-knit Product Design team, report to the Head of Product, partner day to day with Research, Product Management, and Development, and work with other teams as collaborators and stakeholders. It's a hands-on senior design role with the opportunity to grow into leading the PD team as it scales, while staying close to the design work Your primary canvas is MyKinsta, the dashboard where our customers manage their sites, but your scope also extends to the service layer to cover the full user experience of Kinsta. This means a design output can include internal workflows, customer communication, or additional tooling. You'll work with a high level of autonomy while you design features, manage stakeholders, provide UX guidance, and occasionally step in to own a project through delivery. The ideal Kinsta Senior Product Designer is a strong craftsperson, a confident decision-maker, curious, collaborative, and self-motivated. What You'll Do: Own design projects end to end (concept, scoping, user flows, UI, release, and follow-up), at any scale, from small improvements to strategic new capabilities. Drive discovery: define what to build to address real problems and user needs, and study competitors and best practices.

jobs.title: UX Research Intern
jobs.description: About baesh baesh is a social platform connecting people in real life through events, communities, and shared interests. We’re a small team using AI to move quickly from ideas to working experiences. Research is central to how we decide what to build and whether it’s good enough to ship. Your work will help us stay close to people as the technology moves faster. You’ll work closely with our Head of Product and UX , an experienced researcher with a PhD in emotional and behavioural research. You’ll get practical guidance across the research process—from deciding what to investigate to helping the team act on what we learn. This is an unpaid mandatory internship for students whose university programme requires a placement. Location: Mostly remote, with opportunities to join research and events in Berlin. Start date: Flexible, depending on your university requirements. Duration: As required by your university, usually 3–6 months. What you’ll help with Usability testing and idea validation Help plan and run usability tests on our app and prototypes, including interfaces built with AI. Explore how easily people can discover events, join communities, and create their profiles. Test whether experiences make sense to real people, beyond looking polished or functioning technically. Validate early ideas and assumptions before the team invests further. Identify confusing moments and recommend improvements that make a meaningful difference. Exploratory research and interviews Help interview existing users and people who haven’t tried baesh yet. Explore how people make friends, find things to do, and connect with communities. Understand their needs, motivations, habits, and barriers. Help write discussion guides and ask open questions that uncover useful insights. Bring people’s experiences into product decisions, keeping the human connection at the heart of how we build. AI-supported research Use AI to help draft interview guides, usability-testing scripts, and survey questions.

jobs.title: UI Engineer (Based in CA or NC only)
jobs.description: Mission: Live at the intersection of app runtime & security. Protect applications in a fundamental way so that developers can build great application services and not be constantly looking over their shoulder. BlueRock is changing the landscape of App runtime security. The role Location: Must be based in CA (preferably San Francisco Bay Area) or North Carolina You will work alongside BlueRock's product designers and the control plane development team on our operator consoles. These are the React front ends that engineers and security teams use to manage large fleets of protected nodes, see what AI agents are actually doing across those fleets, and author the policy that constrains them. The domain is AI and agentic systems, seen from the operations and security side. When an agent calls an MCP server, spawns a subagent, runs a shell command in a sandbox, or burns $40 of tokens in an afternoon, our UI is where a person sees it, understands it, and decides what to allow. So the interesting problems are visibility problems (how do you show a thousand agent sessions so someone can find the one that matters?) and control problems (how do you author an enforcement policy without a mistake taking production down?). This is a mid-level role. We expect about 3–5 years of professional front-end experience, or equivalent work that clearly shows the same judgment. The ideal candidate is passionate about user experience, design, and AI-assisted software development, with a demonstrated grounding in engineering best practices. The title says UI, but the work doesn’t stop there: you’ll work closely with our backend services, and a feature is finished when it’s proven working live, not when the screen looks right. jobs.description: Your mission At Doctolib, we're building digital health solutions used by more than 90 million patients and 520,000 healthcare professionals across Europe. As Engineering Manager of the Design System team, you will lead the engineering efforts behind Oxygen, Doctolib's design system. Oxygen goes far beyond a component library: it is the infrastructure that ensures design quality at scale and delivers our brand identity consistently across an AI-first development environment. With over 50 designers and several hundred engineers building across multiple markets and product surfaces, your work directly shapes the experience of every user who interacts with Doctolib. Working at the intersection of Design and Engineering, you will partner with designers, product managers, and engineers to turn our Design System vision into scalable technical solutions that power consistent, high-quality user interfaces across all Doctolib products. What you'll do Define your team's vision, strategy, and roadmap alongside your Product partner, bringing strong technical perspectives to shape and challenge priorities, and take end-to-end ownership of engineering delivery and quality. Lead the technical design, development, and evolution of Oxygen , ensuring its components and foundations are accessible, robust, reusable, and scalable across our products. Champion an AI-first approach , exploring and scaling AI-powered tools and workflows that help designers and engineers build high-quality user interfaces more efficiently. Establish and promote UI and accessibility engineering best practices , working closely with designers, product teams, and our accessibility specialist to drive adoption across the organization. Drive technical alignment across engineering teams , fostering collaboration and ensuring the Design System integrates seamlessly

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: About us At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Agentic AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn't just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too. The role Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer. You will own Workflows and Integrations. That covers the workflow builder, templates, scheduling and run management, and the steps that workflows are built from. It also covers the platform's third-party connections outside media: digital asset management systems, file storage such as Google Drive, translation services, data services such as Foreplay, and more than a hundred other business tools. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients. You will also own how workflows show up inside Scribble, our creative agent. Agents can already run as steps inside a workflow. The next step is for Scribble to find, build, change and run workflows on a person's behalf and report back as they run, and for a workflow to pause for a person's decision and act on it.
